quote: Congress’s amendment of this statute is not clearly irreconcilable with our precedent upholding a “motivating purpose” as sufficient under § 2423(b) because Congress may have intended to clarify and confirm what had always been true— that a “motivating purpose” is sufficient for conviction.
cite: United States v. Michael Pepe, 81 F.4th 961 (9th Cir. 2023)
